label: Equal low (3, 0.1 ATR)
gloss: whether this bar recorded a pivot low of length 3 within 0.1 × ATR(200) of the previous recorded one — computed by the server over this timeframe’s bars, LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts v7.0’s legs: a pivot high of length n is a high above every high of the n bars after it, a pivot low a low below every low of the n bars after it, recorded alternately as the leg turns; false on a bar that records no such pivot, absent until the bars read hold the ATR’s 800-bar window and a proven previous pivot

equalBars.description: The equal highs and lows’ pivot length, each side (LuxAlgo’s Bars Confirmation).

equalThreshold.description: How close two pivots must be to be equal, as a fraction of ATR(200) at the deciding bar.
